notes.zh:
Tactile 0.21 重点更新：
• 置顶截图贴图全面支持按住鼠标左键任意区域随心拖拽移动位置，首点即响应无需预先激活
• 置顶截图贴图全面支持自如缩放：双指捏合缩放、双指/滚轮平滑缩放、右下角鼠标拖拉缩放、键盘 ⌘+/⌘-/⌘0 缩放、右键快捷菜单比例调节及 ⎋ Esc / 双击快速关闭
• 新增出厂极简预设场景，支持一键将当前配置保存为极简场景
• 快捷键录制全局按键吞咽隔离，100% 屏蔽其他外部应用干扰
• 智能快捷键冲突探测预警（Carbon 全局热键与 macOS 系统快捷键）
• 修复窗口靠右半屏吸附图标显示反向问题
• 过滤系统后台守护进程，彻底根除 pid 186 权限异常警告与拖拽监测 CPU 负载
• 深度根除 Swift 协程定时器堆积内存泄漏，剪贴板超大图片转入高速磁盘缓存，空闲时自动瘦身
• 优化多指轻扫（3指/4指）灵敏度与指尖抬起瞬时检测
• 支持 5 指自然手型检测、掌心误触过滤与双指绘字间距自适应微调
notes.en:
Tactile 0.21 Highlights:
• Pinned screenshot stickers can be dragged anywhere by holding the left mouse button, with instant first-click response
• Pinned screenshots fully support scaling: pinch-to-zoom, scroll wheel zoom, corner drag resizing, ⌘+/⌘-/⌘0 zoom, right-click presets, and Esc / double-click close
• Added built-in minimalist preset scene with one-click current settings save
• Global key-swallowing during shortcut recording, shielding all background apps
• Smart shortcut conflict detection (Carbon hotkeys & macOS system keys)
• Fixed right half window snap icon orientation
• Filtered system daemon processes, eliminating pid 186 task port errors and drag monitoring CPU overhead
• Fixed deep Swift Concurrency timer memory leak, offloaded clipboard images to disk cache
• Enhanced 3-finger and 4-finger swipe responsiveness and lift-off flick detection
• Natural 5-finger hand perception, palm rejection, and auto-tuning character drawing spacing
